subject.why: The spyglass is immediately recognisable with its three stepped brass sections, red leather wrap, front lens, and eyepiece.

category.why: The object floats cleanly in three-quarter view against a single-colour gradient background with a centered motif pattern.

clean.why: There are no text elements, borders, watermarks, UI, or characters.

framing.why: The spyglass is centered diagonally with comfortable margins on all corners and edges.

colour.why: The vibrant purple background provides strong contrast against the warm golden brass and rich red wrap.

detail.why: The forms are bold and chunky with no extraneous clutter, micro-textures, or unrequested props.

style.why: Features smooth volumes, soft highlights, satin sheen, and clear material readability matching the reference cards.

bg_colour.why: background is purple (100% of the background); planned purple
